**The argument — TTW reference notes**

Reynolds recounts last season: Penn State's playoff and title aspirations, a double-overtime home loss to Oregon that began a six-game slide, and James Franklin's firing after consecutive defeats as a 20-point favourite at UCLA and against Northwestern, before the team rallied under interim coach Terry Smith — still on staff as assistant head coach — to reach and win a bowl. Now Matt Campbell arrives with 24 transfers from Iowa State, seven offensive and four defensive starters among them. Reynolds calls it Curt Cignetti's James Madison-to-Indiana move from two years ago on steroids.

*Rests on:* coaching (Campbell's arrival); a mass transfer of his former players; the prior season's collapse as the baseline
